title: Learning Fair Policies in Multiobjective (Deep) Reinforcement Learning with Average and Discounted Rewards
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical formulation and optimization of fairness within multi-objective reinforcement learning. While it utilizes principles from social welfare theory (such as the Pigou-Dalton principle) to define its objective function, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral systems, or ethics as a subject matter, focusing instead on algorithmic resource allocation and efficiency.
